- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: Robinson arithmetic / Peano arithmetic / true arithmetic / model of arithmetic
- Intended sense: Robinson arithmetic / Peano arithmetic / true arithmetic / model of arithmetic
- Chosen Pashto: د رابنسن حساب / د پيانو حساب / رښتينی حساب / د حساب مدل
- Rationale: Robinson arithmetic supplies the weak finite axioms Q, Peano arithmetic adds induction, and true arithmetic is the complete theory of the standard natural-number structure. These labels remain separate throughout the model constructions.

## TERM-NONSTANDARD-ARITHMETIC-BLOCKS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: successor / predecessor / block / dense ordering of non-standard blocks
- Intended sense: successor / predecessor / block / dense ordering of non-standard blocks
- Chosen Pashto: جانشين / مخکښېنی / بلاک / د نامعياري بلاکونو ګڼ ترتيب
- Rationale: A block contains the finitely many successor and predecessor iterates around one nonstandard element. Distinct blocks are ordered by the interpreted less-than relation and, in an enumerable model, form a denumerable dense order without endpoints. Zero is excluded from the predecessor claim.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, order, countability and induction roles supported by regional sources; exact nonstandard block vocabulary is provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «جانشين / مخکښېنی / بلاک / د نامعياري بلاکونو ګڼ ترتيب» the clearest conventional rendering of “successor / predecessor / block / dense ordering of non-standard blocks” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

  - `PK-IQRAM-P1-PROSE` (checked_context_only): Bushra Iqram. Pashto Semantics. Pakistan; Pashto Academy, University of Peshawar. https://pashto.org.pk/index.php/path/article/download/46/32/69 — The native prose uses کښې and Pakistani final ے in expository constructions; it distinguishes communication through words and sentences. Consulted for expository phrasing and spelling, not set-theoretic terminology.
  - `GRAMMAR-P166-SOV` (checked_supports): Habibullah Tegey and Barbara Robson. A Reference Grammar of Pashto. Supports verb-final exposition. Page manually inspected from scan; no OCR text claim.
  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P109-RELATION` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. Afghanistan; regional comparator only. https://ecampus-afghanistan.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Mathematical-Logic-Sultan-Ahmad-Niazman.pdf — Definition 1.13 interprets a k-place predicate by a k-place relation P contained in M to the kth power. Native technical attestation for relation and its connection with Cartesian powers; Afghan regional comparator. Source display uses subseteq; OpenLogic controls each exact formula.
  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P147-FUNCTIONS` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. Afghan Pashto regional comparator; rendered page visually inspected for this functions batch.

Exact adjective choices differ from the edition and are recorded as regional alternatives; no Pakistani standard inferred.
  - `AF-BUKOVSKY-P99-COUNTABILITY` (checked_supports): Lev Bukovský; Pashto translation by Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Sets and All That About Them / سیټونه او هر څه د هغوی په هکله (1399 / 2020). Afghanistan; Nangarhar University Science Faculty; regional comparator only. https://ecampus-afghanistan.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Sets-and-all-that-about-them-Sultan-Ahmad-Niazman.pdf — Defines countability by an injection into N, includes finite sets and N itself, defines listability by a surjection from N, and proves the nonempty equivalence. Rendered page visually inspected; Afghan regional comparator.

Supports countable infinity and indexing; no claim that the short paragraph supplies the full enumeration proof. Rendered page visually inspected; Afghan regional comparator.

Afghanistan; Nangarhar University Science Faculty; regional comparator only. https://ecampus-afghanistan.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Sets-and-all-that-about-them-Sultan-Ahmad-Niazman.pdf — States mathematical induction for a property of every natural number: the property holds at zero and preservation from n to n+1 yields the universal conclusion. It also proves the principle through the set of naturals satisfying the property. Direct regional concept and proof-language evidence; OpenLogic controls its Dedekind-algebra generalization.

## TERM-INTERPOLATION-SEPARATION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: interpolation theorem / interpolant / separates / inseparable
- Intended sense: interpolation theorem / interpolant / separates / inseparable
- Chosen Pashto: د منځګړيتوب قضيه / منځګړی / بېلوي / نه بېلېدونکی
- Rationale: An interpolant C lies semantically between A and B and uses only their shared nonlogical vocabulary. Separation is the equivalent two-set formulation; inseparability means that no sentence in the common language separates the sets.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. entailment, sentence and proof concepts supported by regional sources; exact interpolation and separation labels are provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «د منځګړيتوب قضيه / منځګړی / بېلوي / نه بېلېدونکی» the clearest conventional rendering of “interpolation theorem / interpolant / separates / inseparable” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-EXPLICIT-IMPLICIT-DEFINABILITY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: definability / explicit definition / implicit definition / Beth definability theorem
- Intended sense: definability / explicit definition / implicit definition / Beth definability theorem

- Rationale: An explicit definition gives an L-formula equivalent to P. An implicit definition requires any two P-expansions of the same L-structure satisfying the theory to assign the same relation to P. Beth's theorem identifies these two conditions.

## TERM-ABSTRACT-LOGIC

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: abstract logic / normal logic / elementary equivalence in L
- Intended sense: abstract logic / normal logic / elementary equivalence in L
- Chosen Pashto: انتزاعي منطق / نورمال منطق / په L کښې ابتدايي هم‌ارزي
- Rationale: An abstract logic assigns a sentence set and satisfaction relation to every language. A normal logic obeys the stated invariance and closure properties. L-elementary equivalence compares truth of all sentences supplied by that abstract logic, not only ordinary first-order sentences.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. logic, sentence, semantic and proof concepts supported by regional sources; exact abstract-logic and normality labels are provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «انتزاعي منطق / نورمال منطق / په L کښې ابتدايي هم‌ارزي» the clearest conventional rendering of “abstract logic / normal logic / elementary equivalence in L” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

Direct regional concept evidence for satisfaction and entailment; the edition uses valuation-based definitions and preserves OpenLogic notation.
  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P33-VALUATION-SATISFIABILITY` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. Direct regional concept evidence for valuation semantics and satisfiability; OpenLogic definitions govern the exact scope and the edition uses a clearer satisfiable label.

  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P39-THEORY-PROOF` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. ## TERM-COMPUTABILITY-FOUNDATIONS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: computability / computable numerical function / model of computation
- Intended sense: computability / computable numerical function / model of computation
- Chosen Pashto: محاسبه کېدنه / محاسبه کېدونکې عددي تابع / د محاسبې مدل
- Rationale: Computability names effective calculation independently of any one formalism. A computable numerical function maps tuples of naturals to naturals by an effective procedure, while a model of computation is a precise formal account of such procedures.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. zero, successor, projection, substitution and recursion concepts are directly supported by a regional source; the computability abstract noun and model compound remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «محاسبه کېدنه / محاسبه کېدونکې عددي تابع / د محاسبې مدل» the clearest conventional rendering of “computability / computable numerical function / model of computation” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-PRIMITIVE-RECURSION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: primitive recursion / primitive recursive function / base equation / recursive equation
- Intended sense: primitive recursion / primitive recursive function / base equation / recursive equation
- Chosen Pashto: بنسټيز بازګښت / بنسټيزه بازګشتي تابع / بنسټيزه معادله / بازګشتي معادله
- Rationale: Primitive recursion fixes an initial value and each next value from the immediately preceding value plus parameters. Primitive recursive functions form the least class containing the basic functions and closed under composition and primitive recursion.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. recursion, zero, successor and induction pattern directly supported by regional sources; the exact primitive-recursion compound and equation labels remain provisional

If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-PROJECTION-CHARACTERISTIC

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: projection function / characteristic function / arity / zero function
- Intended sense: projection function / characteristic function / arity / zero function
- Chosen Pashto: پروجکشن تابع / ځانګړونکې تابع / ځاييزه کچه / صفر تابع
- Rationale: A projection returns one selected input and lets composition reorder, identify or ignore arguments. Arity counts input places. A characteristic function represents membership or a relation by numerical outputs, while the zero function constantly returns zero.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. zero and projection functions and multi-place operations are directly supported by a regional source; projection loanword, characteristic-function compound and arity label remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «پروجکشن تابع / ځانګړونکې تابع / ځاييزه کچه / صفر تابع» the clearest conventional rendering of “projection function / characteristic function / arity / zero function” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-BOUNDED-MINIMIZATION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: bounded minimization / bounded search / least witness
- Intended sense: bounded minimization / bounded search / least witness
- Chosen Pashto: محدوده کمينه‌موندنه / محدوده پلټنه / تر ټولو وړوکے شاهد
- Rationale: Bounded minimization searches only below or through an explicit bound and returns the least witness, with the stated fallback when no witness exists. Keep it distinct from unbounded minimization, which may fail to terminate.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function and induction concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the exact bounded-search compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «محدوده کمينه‌موندنه / محدوده پلټنه / تر ټولو وړوکے شاهد» the clearest conventional rendering of “bounded minimization / bounded search / least witness” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-PRIME-SEQUENCE-CODING

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: prime / factor / factorial / sequence code / concatenate / element / length
- Intended sense: prime / factor / factorial / sequence code / concatenate / element / length
- Chosen Pashto: اوليه عدد / عامل / فاکتوريل / د لړۍ کوډ / نښلول / غړے / اوږدوالی
- Rationale: Prime-power coding represents a finite sequence by one natural number. Length counts indexed entries, element names the decoded entry, and concatenation preserves the complete order of both input sequences. A factor divides the coded number; factorial remains the conventional technical loanword.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. sequence, pairing, power and function concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the grouped coding and concatenation labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «اوليه عدد / عامل / فاکتوريل / د لړۍ کوډ / نښلول / غړے / اوږدوالی» the clearest conventional rendering of “prime / factor / factorial / sequence code / concatenate / element / length” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-RECURSION-VARIANTS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: simultaneous recursion / course-of-values recursion / parameter-changing recursion
- Intended sense: simultaneous recursion / course-of-values recursion / parameter-changing recursion
- Chosen Pashto: هممهاله بازګښت / د ارزښتونو د بهير بازګښت / د پاراميټرونو بدلېدونکی بازګښت
- Rationale: Simultaneous recursion defines several outputs together, course-of-values recursion may use the complete earlier value sequence, and parameter-changing recursion updates parameters during the recursion. Preserve each schema's arities and dependency direction.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. recursion and sequence concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the three exact variant labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «هممهاله بازګښت / د ارزښتونو د بهير بازګښت / د پاراميټرونو بدلېدونکی بازګښت» the clearest conventional rendering of “simultaneous recursion / course-of-values recursion / parameter-changing recursion” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-DIAGONAL-ACKERMANN

## TERM-PARTIAL-RECURSIVE-SEARCH

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: partial computable / partial recursive / unbounded search / divergence
- Intended sense: partial computable / partial recursive / unbounded search / divergence
- Chosen Pashto: جزوي محاسبه کېدونکې / جزوي بازګشتي / بې‌حده پلټنه / نۀ درېدل
- Rationale: A partial function may be undefined because its computation does not halt. Unbounded minimization returns the least zero only when every earlier queried value is defined; it diverges if an earlier computation diverges. Keep partial computable model-independent and partial recursive tied to the recursive-function presentation.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function and domain concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the exact partial-computability and unbounded-search compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «جزوي محاسبه کېدونکې / جزوي بازګشتي / بې‌حده پلټنه / نۀ درېدل» the clearest conventional rendering of “partial computable / partial recursive / unbounded search / divergence” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?
- Authorities:
  - `PK-IQRAM-P1-PROSE` (checked_context_only): Bushra Iqram. Pashto Semantics. Pakistan; Pashto Academy, University of Peshawar. https://pashto.org.pk/index.php/path/article/download/46/32/69 — The native prose uses کښې and Pakistani final ے in expository constructions; it distinguishes communication through words and sentences. Consulted for expository phrasing and spelling, not set-theoretic terminology.
  - `GRAMMAR-P166-SOV` (checked_supports): Habibullah Tegey and Barbara Robson. A Reference Grammar of Pashto. Reference grammar; Afghan-central examples, regional comparator. https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED399825.pdf — Word order discussion places modifiers before the verb and treats be-sentence complements as complements, not direct objects. Supports verb-final exposition. Page manually inspected from scan; no OCR text claim.
  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P147-FUNCTIONS` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. Afghanistan; regional comparator only. https://ecampus-afghanistan.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Mathematical-Logic-Sultan-Ahmad-Niazman.pdf — Native number-theoretic exposition defines zero, successor and projection functions and builds new functions by substitution and recursion. Supports تابع and the successor example, with general composition concept illustrated by substitution. Exact injection, surjection, bijection and inverse labels remain provisional. Afghan Pashto regional comparator; rendered page visually inspected for this functions batch.
  - `AF-NIAZMAN-P110-OPERATION` (checked_supports): Sultan Ahmad Niazman. Mathematical Logic / د ریاضي منطق. Supports operation, value and multiple-input concepts, not the particular OpenLogic conventions about codomains or partial domains. Afghan Pashto regional comparator; rendered page visually inspected for this functions batch.

## TERM-NORMAL-FORM-INDEX

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: normal form theorem / index / computation sequence / universal partial function
- Intended sense: normal form theorem / index / computation sequence / universal partial function
- Chosen Pashto: د نورمال شکل قضيه / شاخص / د محاسبې لړۍ / نړيواله جزوي تابع
- Rationale: An index codes a definition or program, while a computation-sequence code records one run on one input. The normal form first searches for a valid run code and then extracts its output. Universal means that varying the index enumerates every partial computable function, not that one total function computes every total computable function.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, enumeration, pairing and sequence concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact normal-form and universal-function labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «د نورمال شکل قضيه / شاخص / د محاسبې لړۍ / نړيواله جزوي تابع» the clearest conventional rendering of “normal form theorem / index / computation sequence / universal partial function” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

- Intended sense: halting problem / halting function / noncomputable
- Chosen Pashto: د درېدنې مسئله / د درېدنې تابع / محاسبه کېدونکې نۀ
- Rationale: The halting function asks whether the indexed computation on the given input returns a value. Its diagonal contradiction concerns definedness versus divergence. Noncomputable means no effective function solves all instances; it does not mean that individual terminating computations cannot be recognized after they halt.

## TERM-GENERAL-RECURSION-THEORY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: general recursive function / regular function / recursion theory / Church's thesis
- Intended sense: general recursive function / regular function / recursion theory / Church's thesis
- Chosen Pashto: عمومي بازګشتي تابع / منظمه تابع / د بازګښت تيوري / د چرچ اصل
- Rationale: A regular total function has a zero for every parameter tuple, so unbounded search remains total. General recursive and total recursive denote extensionally the same total functions despite different definitions. Church's thesis links the formal models to the informal notion of effective computation and is not a mathematical theorem within one model.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. recursion and function concepts are supported by regional sources; the historic class, regularity and Church-thesis labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «عمومي بازګشتي تابع / منظمه تابع / د بازګښت تيوري / د چرچ اصل» the clearest conventional rendering of “general recursive function / regular function / recursion theory / Church's thesis” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-UNIVERSAL-DIAGONAL-COMPUTATION

- Chosen Pashto: نړيواله جزوي تابع / نړيواله هرځاے تعريف شوې تابع / قطري استدلال / د درېدنې ناپرېکړتيا

No total computable function uniformly lists all total computable unary functions, by diagonalization. The halting predicate is total as a set-theoretic function but not computable; preserve these three distinct totality claims.

## TERM-COMPUTABLE-SET-CHARACTERISTIC

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: computable set / computable relation / characteristic function / decidable set
- Intended sense: computable set / computable relation / characteristic function / decidable set
- Chosen Pashto: محاسبه کېدونکے سټ / محاسبه کېدونکې اړيکه / ځانګړونکې تابع / د پرېکړې وړ سټ
- Rationale: A set or relation is computable exactly when its total zero-one characteristic function is computable. Here decidable names the same effective yes-or-no property; it must remain distinct from semi-decidable membership, where nonmembers may never receive an answer.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. set, function, relation and countability concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact computability labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «محاسبه کېدونکے سټ / محاسبه کېدونکې اړيکه / ځانګړونکې تابع / د پرېکړې وړ سټ» the clearest conventional rendering of “computable set / computable relation / characteristic function / decidable set” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-COMPUTABLY-ENUMERABLE-SETS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: computably enumerable / recursively enumerable / c.e. / range / semi-decidable
- Intended sense: computably enumerable / recursively enumerable / c.e. / range / semi-decidable
- Chosen Pashto: په محاسبوي ډول د شمېر وړ / په بازګشتي ډول د شمېر وړ / د قيمتونو سټ / نيمه د پرېکړې وړ
- Rationale: Computably enumerable permits the empty set or the range of a total computable function; equivalent forms use a partial range, primitive-recursive range, partial-computable domain or existential projection of a computable relation. Enumeration may repeat and need not be ordered. Semi-decidable means membership eventually yields yes while nonmembership may diverge.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. range and countability concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact effective-enumerability and semi-decidability compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «په محاسبوي ډول د شمېر وړ / په بازګشتي ډول د شمېر وړ / د قيمتونو سټ / نيمه د پرېکړې وړ» the clearest conventional rendering of “computably enumerable / recursively enumerable / c.e. / range / semi-decidable” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-HALTING-SETS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: halting set K_0 / self-halting set K / zero-input halting set K_1
- Intended sense: halting set K_0 / self-halting set K / zero-input halting set K_1
- Chosen Pashto: د درېدنې سټ K_0 / پر خپل ځان د درېدنې سټ K / پر صفر ننوت د درېدنې سټ K_1
- Rationale: Keep K_0, K and K_1 distinct by stating their input convention whenever introduced: arbitrary indexed input pairs, the index applied to itself, and the fixed zero input. Use د درېدنې سټ for the general paired set and preserve each symbolic name thereafter.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, indexing, countability and diagonal concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact three computability-set labels remain provisional

## TERM-CE-CLOSURE-COMPLEMENT

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: closure of c.e. sets under union and intersection / failure of closure under complement
- Intended sense: closure of c.e. sets under union and intersection / failure of closure under complement
- Chosen Pashto: د په محاسبوي ډول د شمېر وړ سټونو د اتحاد او اشتراک لاندې تړلتيا / د متمم لاندې ناتړلتيا
- Rationale: Say a class is د ... لاندې تړلی when the indicated operation preserves membership in the class. C.e. sets are closed under union and intersection, while closure under complement fails; a c.e. set with c.e. complement is computable.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. union, intersection, difference, domain and countability concepts are supported by regional sources; the effective closure compounds remain provisional

If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-MANY-ONE-REDUCIBILITY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: many-one reduction / one-one reduction / Turing reduction / reducible / equivalent
- Intended sense: many-one reduction / one-one reduction / Turing reduction / reducible / equivalent
- Chosen Pashto: ډېر-پر-يو راکمونه / يو-پر-يو راکمونه / ټيورينګ راکمېدنه / راکمېدونکے / معادل
- Rationale: A many-one reduction is one total computable map on natural numbers preserving membership in both directions. Keep the direction explicit as له A څخه B ته راکموي or A، B ته راکمېدونکے دے. Reserve one-one for an injective such map and Turing reduction for procedures allowed to query the target set.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, pairing, set and composition concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact reducibility compounds remain provisional

## TERM-CE-COMPLETENESS-TOTALITY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: complete c.e. set / totality set Tot / totality / arithmetic hierarchy
- Intended sense: complete c.e. set / totality set Tot / totality / arithmetic hierarchy
- Chosen Pashto: بشپړ په محاسبوي ډول د شمېر وړ سټ / د هرځاے تعريف شويو تابعو سټ Tot / هرځاے تعريف کېدل / حسابي پوړيز نظام
- Rationale: A complete c.e. set is itself c.e. and receives a many-one reduction from every c.e. set. Tot denotes indices of computable functions defined on every input; describe that property with هرځاے تعريف rather than importing a word that could be confused with logical completeness. Preserve the hierarchy remark as a brief provisional label.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, countability and diagonal concepts are supported by regional sources; the exact completeness, totality and arithmetic-hierarchy labels remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «بشپړ په محاسبوي ډول د شمېر وړ سټ / د هرځاے تعريف شويو تابعو سټ Tot / هرځاے تعريف کېدل / حسابي پوړيز نظام» the clearest conventional rendering of “complete c.e. set / totality set Tot / totality / arithmetic hierarchy” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: state diagram / instruction / configuration / machine table / doubler / halt / accept
- Intended sense: state diagram / instruction / configuration / machine table / doubler / halt / accept
- Chosen Pashto: د حالت ډياګرام / لارښوونه / تشکيل / د ماشين جدول / دوه‌چنده کوونکے / درېدل / منل
- Rationale: Use تشکيل for a snapshot containing tape contents, current state and head position, keeping it distinct from ترتيب for ordering. A state diagram and machine table encode the same transition instructions; درېدل means no applicable instruction, while منل names the stipulated halting outcome in these examples.

## TERM-TURING-UNARY-COMPUTATION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: unary representation / arithmetic function / partial computation / mover
- Intended sense: unary representation / arithmetic function / partial computation / mover
- Chosen Pashto: يوګونې څرګندونه / حسابي تابع / جزوي محاسبه / لېږدوونکے
- Rationale: Use يوګونې څرګندونه for coding n by n stroke symbols and لېږدوونکے for the machine that relocates a block. Preserve the distinction between a total computation and the permitted divergence or malformed output for an undefined partial-function value.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. natural-number, parity, equality and function language has regional support and Pakistani prose governs register; the exact unary-machine compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «يوګونې څرګندونه / حسابي تابع / جزوي محاسبه / لېږدوونکے» the clearest conventional rendering of “unary representation / arithmetic function / partial computation / mover” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-TURING-HALTING-DISCIPLINE

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: halting state / accept state / reject state / disciplined Turing machine
- Intended sense: halting state / accept state / reject state / disciplined Turing machine
- Chosen Pashto: درېدنی حالت / د منلو حالت / د رد حالت / منضبط ټيورينګ ماشين
- Rationale: Use درېدنی حالت for a designated state where execution stops and منضبط for a machine with one such state, a fixed final head position, and protected end-marker behavior. Keep acceptance and rejection as distinct outcomes.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. Pakistani prose and regional function/relation witnesses support syntax and role distinctions; the exact automata compounds remain provisional

- Rationale: Use ناتعييني when a state-symbol pair can relate to more than one successor triple, and تقليد for reproducing another machine model's computation. Keep function-based deterministic transitions distinct from relation-based branching.

## TERM-TURING-HALTING-DIAGONAL

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: halting function / halting problem / self-input diagonal / unsolvable
- Intended sense: halting function / halting problem / self-input diagonal / unsolvable
- Chosen Pashto: د درېدنې تابع / د درېدنې مسئله / پر خپل شاخص قطري استدلال / ناحل
- Rationale: Use د درېدنې تابع for the total yes/no function on a machine index and input, and د درېدنې مسئله for the corresponding decision problem. The diagonal s(e) asks about M_e on e itself; ناحل means no Turing machine decides every instance.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. function, diagonal and induction concepts are supported by regional sources; exact Turing-machine halting compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «د درېدنې تابع / د درېدنې مسئله / پر خپل شاخص قطري استدلال / ناحل» the clearest conventional rendering of “halting function / halting problem / self-input diagonal / unsolvable” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-FIRST-ORDER-DECISION-PROBLEM

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: decision problem / validity function / reduce the halting problem / unsolvable
- Intended sense: decision problem / validity function / reduce the halting problem / unsolvable
- Chosen Pashto: د پرېکړې مسئله / د اعتبار تابع / د درېدنې مسئله راکمول / ناحل
- Rationale: Use د پرېکړې مسئله for the existence of an effective yes/no procedure for first-order validity. Preserve the reduction direction: a validity decider would compute the halting function through the effectively constructed representation sentence.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. validity, entailment, proof and effective-decision roles are regionally supported; the historical decision-problem compound remains provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «د پرېکړې مسئله / د اعتبار تابع / د درېدنې مسئله راکمول / ناحل» the clearest conventional rendering of “decision problem / validity function / reduce the halting problem / unsolvable” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?
- Authorities:
  - `PK-IQRAM-P1-PROSE` (checked_context_only): Bushra Iqram. Pashto Semantics. Pakistan; Pashto Academy, University of Peshawar. https://pashto.org.pk/index.php/path/article/download/46/32/69 — The native prose uses کښې and Pakistani final ے in expository constructions; it distinguishes communication through words and sentences. Consulted for expository phrasing and spelling, not set-theoretic terminology.

## TERM-TURING-LOGICAL-REPRESENTATION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: represent a Turing machine / numeral / successor / configuration sentence / verification
- Intended sense: represent a Turing machine / numeral / successor / configuration sentence / verification
- Chosen Pashto: د ټيورينګ ماشين تمثيل / عددنښه / تالي / د تشکيل غونډله / تاييد
- Rationale: Use binary Q and S predicates for state/head and tape contents, عددنښه for the canonical successor term, and د تشکيل غونډله for C(M,w,n). Verification combines induction on execution steps with a natural-number structure whose predicates record the actual run.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. predicate, successor, semantics, proof and induction roles are supported by regional sources; the exact representation compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «د ټيورينګ ماشين تمثيل / عددنښه / تالي / د تشکيل غونډله / تاييد» the clearest conventional rendering of “represent a Turing machine / numeral / successor / configuration sentence / verification” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

- Source term or construction: semi-decidable validity / enumerate derivations / positive answer / divergence on a negative instance
- Intended sense: semi-decidable validity / enumerate derivations / positive answer / divergence on a negative instance
- Chosen Pashto: د اعتبار نيمه پرېکړه / د اشتقاقونو اغېزمنه شمېرنه / مثبت ځواب / پر منفي بېلګه نۀ درېدل
- Rationale: Validity is semi-decidable because a machine can enumerate all formal derivations and halt with output one when it finds a derivation of the input sentence. Soundness makes every positive answer correct and completeness guarantees eventual discovery for valid sentences; invalid sentences may make the search diverge.

## TERM-TRAKHTENBROT-FINITE-MODELS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: finite model / finite satisfiability / finite validity / Trakhtenbrot's theorem
- Intended sense: finite model / finite satisfiability / finite validity / Trakhtenbrot's theorem
- Chosen Pashto: متناهي مدل / په متناهي جوړښت کښې د صدق وړتيا / متناهي اعتبار / د تراختن‌بروت قضيه
- Rationale: Finite satisfiability asks for one finite structure satisfying a sentence, while finite validity quantifies over every finite structure. Trakhtenbrot's theorem says finite satisfiability is undecidable. Keep this distinct from the compactness phrase finitely satisfiable, which concerns every finite subset of a sentence set.

## TERM-INCOMPLETENESS-GODEL-INDEPENDENCE

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: independent sentence / Gödel sentence / first and second incompleteness theorems / Presburger arithmetic
- Intended sense: independent sentence / Gödel sentence / first and second incompleteness theorems / Presburger arithmetic
- Chosen Pashto: خپلواکه جمله / د ګوډل جمله / د ناتکميلۍ لومړۍ او دويمه قضيه / د پرېسبورګر حساب
- Rationale: An independent sentence is neither provable nor refutable in the stated theory. A Gödel sentence is the constructed self-referential instance used for the first theorem; the second concerns the theory's own consistency statement. Presburger arithmetic is retained as the contrasting complete decidable theory without multiplication.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. sentence, theorem, consistency, arithmetic and diagonal reasoning have regional support; the exact incompleteness labels and eponym spellings remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «خپلواکه جمله / د ګوډل جمله / د ناتکميلۍ لومړۍ او دويمه قضيه / د پرېسبورګر حساب» the clearest conventional rendering of “independent sentence / Gödel sentence / first and second incompleteness theorems / Presburger arithmetic” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-SYNTAX-GODEL-CODING

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: arithmetization of syntax / symbol code / Gödel number / prime-power sequence coding / formation sequence
- Intended sense: arithmetization of syntax / symbol code / Gödel number / prime-power sequence coding / formation sequence
- Chosen Pashto: د نحو حسابي کول / سمبول-کوډ / ګوډل شمېره / د اوليه عددونو د قوتونو د لړۍ کوډول / جوړښتي لړۍ
- Rationale: A symbol code names the number assigned to one symbol, while a Gödel number codes an entire syntactic sequence. Prime-power coding supplies the sequence mechanism, and a formation sequence witnesses inductive construction. Keep these levels distinct throughout the chapter.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. coding, sequence, countability, formation and arithmetic concepts have regional support; the exact Gödel-coding compounds remain provisional

## TERM-BETA-SEQUENCE-CODING

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: beta function / finite-sequence decoder / pairing function / projection functions
- Intended sense: beta function / finite-sequence decoder / pairing function / projection functions
- Chosen Pashto: بېټا تابعه / د متناهي لړۍ کوډ پرانيستونکې تابعه / جوړوونکې تابعه / پروجکشن تابعې
- Rationale: The beta function decodes the i-th entry from one code d. Its existence requirement covers every finite sequence without requiring a computable encoder. Pairing and its projections package and recover the two parameters used by the decoder.

## TERM-SUNZI-MODULAR-REMAINDER

## TERM-SIGMA1-BOUNDED-COMPLETENESS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: bounded quantifier / Delta-0 formula / Sigma-1 formula / Pi-1 formula / Sigma-1 completeness
- Intended sense: bounded quantifier / Delta-0 formula / Sigma-1 formula / Pi-1 formula / Sigma-1 completeness
- Chosen Pashto: محدود کمیت ايښوونکی / ډېلټا-صفر فارمول / سيګما-يو فارمول / پاي-يو فارمول / د سيګما-يو بشپړتيا
- Rationale: Delta-0 formulas use only propositional connectives and bounded quantifiers. Sigma-1 and Pi-1 formulas add one leading existential or universal quantifier respectively. ## TERM-OMEGA-CONSISTENCY-EXTENSIONS

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: omega-consistent / consistent extension / refutable sentence / theory consistent with Q
- Intended sense: omega-consistent / consistent extension / refutable sentence / theory consistent with Q
- Chosen Pashto: اوميګا-سازګاره / سازګاره غځونه / ردېدونکې جمله / له Q سره سازګاره تيوري
- Rationale: Omega-consistency rules out proving an existential sentence while refuting every numeral instance. Ordinary consistency only rules out proving a sentence together with its negation. An extension includes the earlier theory; being consistent with Q requires only consistency of their union and does not require inclusion.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. consistency, contradiction, proof and natural-number concepts are supported by regional sources; omega-consistency and extension compounds remain provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «اوميګا-سازګاره / سازګاره غځونه / ردېدونکې جمله / له Q سره سازګاره تيوري» the clearest conventional rendering of “omega-consistent / consistent extension / refutable sentence / theory consistent with Q” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-COMPUTABLE-INSEPARABILITY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: universal computable relation / computable separator / computably inseparable / refutable theory complement
- Intended sense: universal computable relation / computable separator / computably inseparable / refutable theory complement
- Chosen Pashto: نړيواله محاسبه کېدونکې اړيکه / محاسبه کېدونکې بېلوونکې / په محاسبوي ډول نه بېلېدونکي / د ردېدونکو جملو سټ
- Rationale: A universal computable relation would uniformly realize every unary computable relation by fixing one parameter, which diagonalization refutes. A separator contains the provable sentences while excluding the refutable ones. Computable inseparability means no computable separator exists, a stronger fact than mere disjointness.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. relation, separation, complement, proof and computability roles are supported by regional sources; the exact effective inseparability compounds remain provisional

## TERM-TRUTH-DEFINABILITY-TARSKI

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: definability in standard arithmetic / truth definition / undefinability of truth
- Intended sense: definability in standard arithmetic / truth definition / undefinability of truth
- Chosen Pashto: په معياري حساب کښې تعريفېدنه / د رښتياوالي تعريف / د رښتياوالي نه تعريفېدنه
- Rationale: Definability in N compares a numerical relation with satisfaction of an arithmetic formula under all standard numeral substitutions. Computable relations are definable, but not conversely; the halting relation is the explicit example. Tarski's result forbids a formula defining the codes of all true arithmetic sentences in arithmetic itself.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. regional sources support exposition, proof and a distinct diagonal verb; the exact semantic and undefinability compounds remain provisional

## TERM-SOL-SET-CODING

## TERM-SOL-ALEPH-ONE-CONTINUUM

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: aleph-one / cardinality of the continuum / continuum hypothesis
- Intended sense: aleph-one / cardinality of the continuum / continuum hypothesis
- Chosen Pashto: الف‌يو / د پيوستار شمېرنيزه اندازه / د پيوستار فرضيه
- Rationale: Aleph-one is the least uncountable cardinal, not a property requiring every proper subset to be countable. - Rationale: Substitution first renames bound variables when needed to avoid capture. One-step beta contraction differs from zero-or-more-step reduction, and a normal form has no beta redex. - Intended sense: Church numeral / iterator / lambda-definable partial function

Lambda-definability of a partial function requires the coded result to reduce to its Church numeral when defined and requires no normal form on undefined input. ## TERM-LAMBDA-PARTIAL-SUBSTITUTION

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: substitution / partial substitution / undefined substitution / variable capture / inverse substitution
- Intended sense: substitution / partial substitution / undefined substitution / variable capture / inverse substitution
- Chosen Pashto: تعويض / قسمي تعويض / ناټاکلے تعويض / د متغير نيونه / معکوس تعويض
- Rationale: Formal lambda substitution is partial: under lambda y, substitution for x is defined only when x differs from y and y is not free in the replacement term. A bound x is not replaced; potential capture makes substitution undefined until alpha-renaming. Free-variable theorems use the two stated definedness conditions, and inverse substitution requires the binder tests in both directions.
- Confidence reason: provisional; best available evidence. Afghan regional comparator prints تعويض for recursive-function composition, while Pakistani prose supports register; exact lambda partiality, capture and inverse compounds remain source-led and provisional
- Expert question: In Pakistani Pashto mathematical prose, is «تعويض / قسمي تعويض / ناټاکلے تعويض / د متغير نيونه / معکوس تعويض» the clearest conventional rendering of “substitution / partial substitution / undefined substitution / variable capture / inverse substitution” while preserving the distinctions in the rationale? If not, what exact replacement and inflected forms should be used?

## TERM-LAMBDA-DE-BRUIJN-INDEX

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `normal`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: De Bruijn index / nameless lambda term / context list / zero-based position / decoding
- Intended sense: De Bruijn index / nameless lambda term / context list / zero-based position / decoding
- Chosen Pashto: د دې بروين شاخص / بې‌نومه لامبډا ترم / د متغيرونو لړ / له صفره شمېرل شوے ځای / بېرته ترلاسه کول
- Rationale: A De Bruijn index counts intervening abstractions from the nearest binder. The context list is zero-based and repeated variable names use the first occurrence from the head, so inner binders shadow outer names. Juxtaposed 0 and 1 in the source denotes application, not a decimal numeral. F encodes ordinary terms relative to a context; G decodes only when the indexed position exists in the relevant context. Preserve the source proposition's one-step alpha-invariance without adding a converse.
- Confidence reason: provisional; no exact De Bruijn label attested in the checked native sources. Pakistani scholarly prose and grammar were visually inspected for register and verb-final syntax; the Afghan regional comparator shows natural-number indexing and function vocabulary, not De Bruijn terminology. The proper-name compound and technical paraphrases remain source-led and provisional

## TERM-LAMBDA-BETA-STRATEGY

- Kind: `terminology`; priority: `high`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`
- Source term or construction: redex / leftmost natural reduction strategy / beta-equivalence
- Intended sense: redex / leftmost natural reduction strategy / beta-equivalence
- Chosen Pashto: رېډکس / د تر ټولو کيڼ رېډکس طبيعي تګلاره / بېټا-معادلتوب
- Rationale: A redex is an applied lambda abstraction eligible for one beta contraction. Beta reduction permits zero or more contractions, unlike one-step contraction. The natural strategy contracts the leftmost redex and reaches a normal form whenever any strategy can. A normal form is unique if it exists, not guaranteed to exist. Beta-equivalence is the compatible equivalence generated by contraction and its inverse; the future indexed extension by X is separate.
